definitions.explanation: Being far away in terms of physical distance. Used primarily as a modifier (遠隔の or in compound words) to describe things done from a distance, especially in technology, medicine, and education.

examples.japanese: {遠隔|えんかく}{操作|そうさ}でエアコンをつけた。
examples.english: I turned on the air conditioner by remote control.

examples.japanese: {遠隔|えんかく}{授業|じゅぎょう}が{増|ふ}えている。
{遠隔|えんかく}{地|ち}にある{病院|びょういん}では、{専門医|せんもんい}とオンラインで{相談|そうだん}できる{遠隔|えんかく}{医療|いりょう}が{役|やく}に{立|た}っている。
examples.english: At hospitals in remote areas, telemedicine for online consultations with specialists has proven useful.

notes:
USAGE:
{遠隔|えんかく} is primarily used as a prefix or modifier in compound words. It became especially common during and after the COVID-19 pandemic with the rise of remote work and online education.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遠隔|えんかく}{操作|そうさ} (remote control/operation)
- {遠隔|えんかく}{授業|じゅぎょう} (remote class, distance learning)
- {遠隔|えんかく}{医療|いりょう} (telemedicine)
- {遠隔|えんかく}{地|ち} (remote area)
- {遠隔|えんかく}{会議|かいぎ} (remote conference)
- {遠隔|えんかく}{勤務|きんむ} (remote work)

Note: Do not confuse with the homophone {沿革|えんかく} (history, development).
